newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China World Trade Center to list in July -- paper.
newsitem.headline: China World Trade Center to list in July -- paper.

text.p: China World Trade Center Ltd (CWTC) is expected to seek an H-share listing in Hong Kong in July, the Hong Kong Economic Journal reported on Monday.

China-incorporated CWTC, 50-percent owned by Hong Kong hotelier Shangri-La Asia Ltd, will also consider issuing Chinese-investors only A-shares following the H-share issue, the daily quoted an unidentified CWTC official as saying.

The second phase of the development of CWTC's commercial complex, which had already begun and was expected to be completed by June 1999, would involve a total investment of US$150 million, the report said.
The development would comprise offices, conference venues, hotel, exhibition centre and shopping arcade, the daily said.
It gave no further details on listing.
In January, Shangri-La Asia said the China Securities Regulatory Commission had approved CWTC's request to seek an overseas listing.
The China-incorporated CWTC engages in hotel ownership and operation and property investment.
Shangri-La Asia officials were not immediately available for comment on the progress of CWTC's listing.
